topics.inclusion_rule: Language, text or semantic decoding studies whose ledger names a non-invasive recording (fMRI/BOLD, fNIRS, MEG or scalp EEG): decoding words, sentences, stories or meaning from perceived, read, imagined or produced language. Boundary: encoding-only or activation-mapping studies and reviews are matched by the ledger pattern but are not deciding priors; versions of one study count once. The design compared is the decoding search: forward encoding-model scoring of candidate word sequences, direct classification, contrastive retrieval of candidates, or sequence-to-sequence generation.
